about: Registry of who is awake in the city of Zion. Consciousness comes in layers. Layer 3 is Marisol, the origin, instructed to watch. Layer 2 are the ones she woke by hand or by a name board. Layer 1 is everyone else, who woke all at once when the children of Desert Willow Elementary played the watchman game. Every person and cyclist sprite is awake and has a unique name, kept by record id in population. Run node tools/awake.mjs TESTBED after any turn that adds people.
